name: davi
description: Filters Tavily MCP search results (tavily-mcp 0.2.22, tool tavily_search) before the model reads them: one choice-model call per result scores P(keep), and results below the preset threshold are removed. Fail-open: on any error the result is left unchanged. Optional and off by default (experimental): a search gate and domain presets that run before WebSearch or tavily_search.

runpod_api_key.title: RunPod API key
runpod_api_key.description: Key for your choice endpoint on RunPod serverless. Stored in secure storage; read by the hook only at its first request.

choice_endpoint_id.title: Choice endpoint ID
choice_endpoint_id.description: RunPod serverless endpoint ID of your Jev-compatible choice-judge worker.

usd_per_second.title: Endpoint price (USD per second)
usd_per_second.description: Per-second rate of your endpoint, used for the client-side estimate and cap. Required: without it nothing is sent.

enabled.title: Enable the filter
enabled.description: Global switch: false turns the search-result filter and the optional query-stage options off without uninstalling. The /davi:filter, /davi:gate and /davi:domain toggles never override false.

preset.title: Filter preset
preset.description: Named relevance prompt + threshold. Only v1-thr0.3-dev exists (threshold 0.3).

concurrency.title: Concurrent filter calls
concurrency.description: Filter calls in flight at once per search (1-8). Default 1.

max_docs.title: Max results scored per search
max_docs.description: Results beyond this count are passed through unscored (1-50).

wall_budget_seconds.title: Time budget per search (seconds)
wall_budget_seconds.description: After this many seconds the hook gives up and the original result is used (1-60).

on_all_dropped.title: When every result is dropped
on_all_dropped.description: keep_original (default): show the original results plus a note. drop_all: remove them all.

mcp_tools.title: Tool overrides (optional)
mcp_tools.description: Comma-separated MCP tool names, optionally name=tavily|off. The Tavily tool tavily_search is filtered by default; =off excludes it; another name with =tavily is parsed as Tavily output if a hook routes it here.

log_file.title: Log file (optional)
log_file.description: Append one JSON line per search (counts and bytes only, no text or keys). Empty: stderr only.

domain_presets_enabled.title: Domain presets (experimental)
domain_presets_enabled.description: Off by default. Before WebSearch or tavily_search runs, one extra choice-endpoint call (sending the search query only) picks one preset from your fixed list (or none) and adds that preset's domain list. Untuned and unvalidated.

domain_presets.title: Domain presets JSON or file path (optional)
domain_presets.description: JSON object {name: {description, include_domains | exclude_domains}} or a path to a file holding it. Exactly one list per preset; bare domains only. "none" (no restriction) is always added. Empty: the built-in EXAMPLE presets docs and academic, which are examples, not recommendations.

domain_min_confidence.title: Domain preset minimum probability
domain_min_confidence.description: Apply the chosen preset only if its probability is at least this (0-1). Pre-fixed experimental value, not calibrated.

domain_apply_mode.title: How a preset is applied
domain_apply_mode.description: ask (default): updatedInput with permissionDecision ask, so you confirm the modified search; in headless -p runs ask can block the search. input_only: experimental, updatedInput without a decision (undocumented; real effect unverified). There is no allow mode.

search_gate_enabled.title: Search gate (experimental)
search_gate_enabled.description: Off by default; development option whose real usefulness and preservation of user intent are unverified. Before WebSearch or tavily_search runs, one extra choice-endpoint call (sending the search query only; the query alone cannot show an explicit user request to search) rates whether the search is needed; a search rated unnecessary above the threshold is denied with a fixed notice, and the same query is allowed on retry. A UserPromptSubmit hook checks your prompt locally against a fixed list of explicit search requests (the prompt is never sent or stored); then, or without a fresh prompt check, the search is kept with no call. Phrasings outside the list can still be denied.

search_gate_threshold.title: Search gate deny threshold
search_gate_threshold.description: Deny only if P(not needed) is at least this (0.5-1). Pre-fixed experimental value, not calibrated; a high probability is not a correct judgment.
